name: Kyoushuujo
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional driving school (Hayate Driving School): a notice about reservation hours changing, a first day working reception, a fee-and-course guide, a first behind-the-wheel lesson with an instructor, a comparison of two new-staff training plans, a column on being nervous during practice lessons, teaching a new instructor how to teach, an essay on why practical skill lessons are emphasized over classroom lessons, a bad-weather lesson cancellation guide, a column on tailoring instruction to each student's personality, a notice of revised enrollment contract terms, a reflection on a straight country road remembered from training days, and a one-year cooperation report on a local elderly driver renewal course. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
